female.sp: Preserve the PMX-002 Bolinoak Sammahn's unmistakable bulky reconnaissance-mobile-suit identity while translating it into a clearly adult, cute-faced glamorous woman. Keep the original olive-green and moss-green armor, dark charcoal joint sections, bright yellow-orange sensor blocks, broad rounded shoulder armor with opened three-tube grenade launchers, the large luminous radome/surveillance sensor integrated as an external mechanical crown above the hair, compact rounded torso armor, thick sensor-equipped forearm armor, layered hip plates, powerful rounded lower-leg armor, and broad armored feet. Retain the asymmetrical dedicated clawed shield on one forearm with its two-finger pincer clearly visible, plus the stored beam saber/tomahawk handles and beam-gun emitter details; keep all weapons and equipment complete and readable. Exactly two biological human arms and two human legs, with mechanical armor and equipment mounted around them; no extra limbs, no fused arms, no robot face, no helmet hiding the face. Keep both shoulder armors present and symmetrical in height. The open armor design may reveal tasteful areas of skin around the upper torso, waist, hips, and thighs while remaining secure and non-transparent. Full-body composition with the complete crown sensor, shoulder launchers, shield claws, hands, leg armor, and feet all entirely inside frame. Soft neutral studio background, no battlefield scenery, no pilot resemblance, no text, no logo, no watermark.
